final.narration: Since December 17, 2024, recent field measurements sit 33.1% below the rating, so published flows are about that much too high. Our best guess is a datum change, but confidence is uncertain. A field note on 2024-12-17 noted "Scour control changed". They disagree because scour would increase readings rather than create a negative shift, while channel velocity dropped significantly, pointing to downstream backwater or fill rather than a simple datum change. Double-check: Resurvey the control section and reference marks to verify whether the post-Helene shift is a downstream fill/backwater condition or an actual gauge datum reset. Trust score 24/100 (Stale).

final.skeptic_argument: The top cause is datum_change with the correct sign, and the shift is large: residual -33.1% with a -0.327 ft step after the gap. But the channel geometry trends the other way for a simple datum issue: area fell 11.3% while velocity fell 22.1%, which is more consistent with downstream backwater/fill than a pure datum reset.

The geometry change shows velocity dropping much more than area (22.1% vs 11.3%), suggesting backwater/fill-like control effects rather than a simple datum change.
